integrity: Finite calculations use independent capped-coin dynamic programming, while the unbounded theorem is derived from an exact representation parametrization and monotone cost argument.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the p=1 first-repeat threshold only, for the fixed three shifted-square offsets 0,1,4, with a>=2. The stabilized quasipolynomials start at a=14. Finite verification does not certify all a. Unindexed or inaccessible prior results remain a possible novelty risk.
title: First-repeat Apéry thresholds of shifted-square triples
